Definition: from G1364; properly, to duplicate, i.e. (mentally) to waver (in opinion):--doubt.
BiblicalUsage: To doubt, to waver between two minds, as Peter doubted while he sank, and even some who saw the risen Jesus on the mountain doubted.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe doubt does not disqualify me, because Jesus caught Peter's hand while he was still doubting and welcomed worshippers who doubted too.
